description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain state persistence using Azure Cosmos DB as the storage provider. It includes setup, multiple test cases for reading, writing, clearing, and format changes, and utilizes Xunit for testing framework.

classes.name: PersistenceProviderTests_Cosmos
classes.description: A test class for validating Orleans grain state persistence operations using Azure Cosmos DB storage backend.

classes.name: TestStoreGrainStateWithCustomJsonProperties
classes.description: A nested class representing grain state with custom JSON property naming for testing serialization behavior.

methods.name: InitializeStorage
methods.description: Initializes and configures the Cosmos-grain storage for testing.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_Azure_Read
methods.description: Test case for reading grain state from Azure Cosmos DB storage.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_Azure_WriteRead
methods.description: Test case for writing and then reading grain state to/from Azure Cosmos DB storage.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_Azure_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Test case for writing, clearing, and then reading grain state in Azure Cosmos DB storage.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_Azure_ChangeReadFormat
methods.description: Test case for changing read format and verifying correct deserialization.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_Azure_ChangeWriteFormat
methods.description: Test case for changing write format and verifying storage/read correctness.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_Read
methods.description: Helper method to perform and verify a read operation from the storage provider.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteRead
methods.description: Helper method to perform write then read operations, asserting correctness.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Helper method to write, clear, then read grain state for tests.
